Emma Chen: Heads-up — Caraway active API calls down ~62% week-over-week. Embeddings traffic basically disappeared. Seen this pattern before with procurement reviews.
Jordan Lee: Yikes. Any advocate changes or notes from CS?
Emma Chen: Yes — their ML lead Priya left 2w ago. New PM (Abe) is doing vendor shortlisting. CS flagged 'cost is primary' in manual notes.
Sophie Patel: Do we have a quick delta by route/model to show where the drop is concentrated?
Carlos Mendes: Pulling numbers now. Will post a short table in a sec.
Emma Chen: Customer is on annual auto-renew; renewal in ~5 months. This feels like early competitive eval.
Carlos Mendes: Quick snapshot:
```
last_7d: total_calls=420 (prev=1100, -62%)
embeddings=8 (prev=540, -98%)
/top routes: /embed (down 99%), /generate down 30%
median latency unchanged
```
Jordan Lee: Thanks. Looks like embeddings drove a lot of value for them — vendor X claims per-embed discounts.
Sophie Patel: Action ideas: 1) cost-savings one-pager (quantization + batching + caching), 2) offer a 90-day Dedicated trial to prove unit economics, 3) 1:1 with SolutionsEng to map integration effort.
Emma Chen: Agreed. I'll own the outreach to Abe and set a 30-min call tomorrow.
Jordan Lee: @Carlos — can you run a side-by-side unit-cost comparison (Redwood current vs. vendor X) and highlight caching/kv benefits? Need numbers for pricing conversation.
Carlos Mendes: On it. ETA EOD Tue. Will include token-level cost, expected savings from prefix caching, and quantization notes.
Sophie Patel: I'll draft the one-pager and a short slide for AE. If we can show a 30–40% TCO delta for their workload, procurement might pause vendor evaluation.
Emma Chen: Note from CS: customer mentioned 'proof of lower ops burden' — add migration checklist + integration time estimate.
renewal-bot: follow-up scheduled 2026-03-25 10:00 for Caraway check-in :calendar:
Abe (Caraway): Thanks Emma — I'll be on the call tomorrow. Cost is the big thing for us right now.
Jordan Lee: Good — set expectation: short technical deep-dive + cost analysis. If we can commit a trial capacity and a CS/SE runbook, we should be able to retain them.
Emma Chen: Plan: (a) Carlos to post cost comparison by EOD Tue, (b) Sophie to share one-pager by Wed morning, (c) Emma to run call with Abe tomorrow and capture procurement asks.
Sophie Patel: I'll cc SalesOps for any concession approvals.
Carlos Mendes: Posting a quick automation snippet I used to estimate per-embed cost:
```
# token cost rough calc
tokens = 1_200_000
price_per_token = 0.0000025
monthly_cost = tokens * price_per_token
```
Emma Chen: Thanks team — keeping this in renewal watch. I'll update thread after call. :eyes:
